projects.title: CORE
projects.description: CORE is a novel COmplex event Recognition Engine developed by my group in collaboration with the University of Hasselt and others. CORE is based on the theoretical framework partially developed by my research group and implements the latest research techniques in the area, with strong guarantees of efficiency. CORE serves as a sandbox to study new features and algorithms in complex event recognition before implementing and testing them there.

projects.title: ReMatch
projects.description: REmatch is a novel regex engine for information extraction. REmatch is based on a recently proposed enumeration algorithm for evaluating regular expressions with capture variables supporting the all-match semantics. Our purpose is to develop a new generation of regex engines and information extraction tools based on research in logic, automata theory, and algorithms.
